subject: 68 days and a secret feature unlocked
preview_text: You've been with us for 68 days. Here's something only long-term users get.
body_paragraphs: Remember staring at that blank page at 2AM, deadline screaming, and your brain just... nothing? That was 68 days ago. Since then, you've written papers, generated thesis statements, and probably aced a few assignments. I've been watching the data, and you're part of the 12% who stick around this long. That means something.

So here's a direct thank you: you're not just another user. You're the reason we keep building this thing. And because you've been with us since the early days, I'm unlocking a backstage pass to something most people never see. It's not in the app store, not on the website. It's just for you.

Open the app right now and tap the 'Insider' tab that just appeared. Inside, you'll find a live dashboard showing exactly how the app grades your thesis before you submit it—real-time Turnitin risk scores, citation accuracy, and grade predictions. Plus, a direct line to our development team for feature requests. This is our way of saying 'we see you, and we appreciate you.'

Open Thesis Generator and check your new Insider tab. It's waiting. P.S. The first 50 people who use it this week get a free one-on-one session with our team to optimize your next paper. No catch, just our thanks.
